about: Static DRAM (.dram0.bss + .dram0.data) per shipped variant, checked by check_static_dram.py on every release image. baseline: the last measured tree, the merge of the release line into main (78fd558e, 1 Nov 2026), so a report reads as growth since then. ceiling: the v4.5.15 ELF (b38e0a51) + 1024 B, unchanged by that re-base. Raising a ceiling needs the bench heap A/B (idle and request-start free heap, before and after) in the PR.
engine2_about: Engine-2 images (lane RB-I0), checked by check_static_dram.py like the shipped variants but kept apart from them: release.yml ships none yet (RB-FLIP adds a shipped e2 variant to `variants` when it ships). baseline: measured at rb-main engine2_baseline_sha (lane E2-GATE, 24 Nov 2026). ceiling: baseline + 2048 B of declared room (ruling 121): a policy line, not the physical limit; growth above the baseline must be declared (allowance_how), and using more than the room needs the bench heap A/B and a ruling.
allowance_how: How a lane declares static DRAM growth (ruling 121): add "static_dram_bytes": N (bytes, an integer) to the lane's tools/release_gate/image_budget.d/<lane>.json, the same file as its image allowance (allowance_bytes 0 when the image does not grow), with the measured figure in its why. check_static_dram.py --lane <lane>, or any run on a lane/<lane> branch while engine2_baseline_sha is fresh, fails an engine-2 image whose growth over its baseline exceeds N, even under the ceiling; no declaration is 0 B. A declaration never lifts the ceiling. After a merge the orchestrator re-measures the engine-2 baselines (and this sha) with the image baseline.
